jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Antwerp to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Pick up at Sint-Jansplein 

• Departure at 4u30

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

As Warehouse Operator, you will execute in an accurate manner tasks concerning both the physical handling and administration aspect of goods that are received, stocked, delivered to internal customers and shipped to external contacts.

The assignment

• Make sure that goods are stored and registered in the appropriate location
• Stock counts
• Check stock of standard goods in the cleanroom and ensure sufficient and timely supply within shelf life and register accordingly
• Deliver goods to cleanroom upon request of internal customers and register accordingly
• Receive goods from internal customers, pack, label and ship to external location taking into account applicable legislation

• You work efficiently, accurately and neatly and have an eye for safety.
• You are energetic, not afraid of physical work and have a great sense of responsibility.
• Your team spirit guarantees a flexible working arrangement.
• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good knowledge of English.
• A certificate for operation of an electric stacker and forklift driving license is a plus.
• You preferably have several years of experience in administrative processing, experience with SAP is a plus.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

Handle complex customer-related issues and support the team in finding effective solutions.

Contribute to cross-functional projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

people management experience and know how to motivate, coach and develop a team.

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

jobs.occupation: Comptable Junior/Medior I FR-EN I Bruxelles
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading Belgian communications and marketing company, with offices in the heart of Brussels and close to the trainstation.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage supplier invoices from receipt to approval and posting
• Ensure correct VAT treatment and support monitoring
• Prepare and process supplier payments on time
• Handle payments through Isabel and ensure proper controls
• Follow up on supplier payment reminders
• Perform AP/AR reconciliations and monitor customer and supplier balances
• Manage bank transactions and financial documentation
• Support monthly closings, audits and annual accounts

• At least a first experience in accounting or finance operations
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent experience
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken). Dutch is a strong plus
• Solid knowledge of Belgian accounting and VAT regulations
• Comfortable working with ERP systems, payment tools and reconciliation processes
• Autonomous, structured, detail-oriented and proactive
• Strong team player with good communication and prioritization skills

jobs.occupation: Recruitment Consultant I Open to Graduates & Junior Profiles
jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you will help companies identify their future talent while supporting candidates throughout their career journeys. It's a dynamic, entrepreneurial and people-focused role where no two days are the same.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities
 

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

jobs.occupation: Product Specialist Fiber Lasers & Press Brakes - Europe
jobs.description:
European HQ Brussels | Fiber Laser & Press Brake Expertise | Technical & Commercial Support | International En
Join the European headquarters of an international CNC machine tool manufacturer as a Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake in Brussels. In this permanent role, you will combine technical product expertise with commercial support, helping dealers, sales teams and customers across Europe find the right fiber laser and press brake solutions.
 You will work in an international environment and travel approximately one week per month across Europe for customer and dealer visits, machine demonstrations and trade fairs.

 Job at a glance

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch and English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field
• Benefits: Electric company car, charging or fuel card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
About the organisation

This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centers, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
To further strengthen its fiber laser and press brake activities in Europe, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical expertise with strong commercial awareness.
 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy and short communication lines.

 

 
Your new role
As Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake, you will be the European point of reference for fiber laser and press brake solutions.

You will support dealers, sales teams and end customers throughout the commercial and technical process, from pre-sales and machine configuration to demonstrations, training, product launches and technical support.

What will you do?

• Provide technical support for product- and application-related questions.
• Advise customers, dealers and sales teams on applications and suitable machine configurations.
• Analyse and resolve product-related technical challenges.
• Support dealers and sales teams throughout commercial sales processes.
• Develop clear product positioning and technical sales arguments.
• Deliver product and application training to dealers and sales teams.
• Demonstrate fiber laser and press brake machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support new product launches across the European market.
• Gather customer, dealer and market feedback and identify potential business opportunities.
• Collaborate with Sales, Service, Marketing and Product Management.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.The position covers the European market, with approximately one week of international travel per month.
 
 
What do you need? Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field.
• Experience in a technical, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects and working with internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• A proactive and results-oriented mindset.
• Fluent Dutch and English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.Your strengths
 You are eager to learn and motivated to develop in-depth knowledge of fiber laser, press brake and CNC machine technologies. You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and commercial thinking, and you are comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders across different European markets.

You'll be part of a renewable energy consultancy with global reach, focused on creating sustainable solutions for tomorrow. The culture of the company is more informal but in a professional way, open and supportive, offering you both professional growth and the chance to contribute to meaningful projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain and update internal systems and databases (e.g. project tracking, HR and finance tools)
• Coordinate schedules and resources for internal programmes and training sessions
• Assist with reporting, data checks and preparing presentations for management
• Support HR processes such as onboarding administration and training follow-up
• Handle administrative follow-up for suppliers and internal approvals
• Ensure accurate documentation, filing and archiving (digital and hard copy)
• Take on ad hoc administrative tasks that keep the office and operations running smoothly

• 2  years of experience in administration, coordination or office support
• Organised, detail-oriented and flexible in handling different priorities
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• A strong communicator in English, Dutch (and French)
• Proactive, service-minded and a natural team player
• Diploma in administration, business or similar is a plus but not required

Our client is a leading professional services organization operating a network of accounting and advisory offices across Belgium. Driven by strong growth ambitions and a continuous focus on innovation, the company has invested significantly in digital transformation, process excellence, and modern technologies to support both its employees and clients.As part of its long-term strategy, the company is building a future-oriented environment where technology and people work hand in hand. The Digital Team plays a key role in this journey by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, standardize ways of working, and unlock the potential of emerging technologies across the business.To support this journey, they are seeking a Digital & Process Expert (AI) to play a key role in shaping and delivering their digital transformation initiatives.

Jobomschrijving

As a Digital Expert, you will play a central role in shaping and accelerating the organization's digital and AI transformation agenda.Your responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing existing business processes across accounting offices and identifying opportunities for optimization, standardization, and automation.
• Defining future-state processes and selecting the most appropriate technologies to support them.
• Driving the adoption of digital tools such as accounting, reporting, workflow, and collaboration platforms.
• Identifying and implementing AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, reduce manual work, and improve service quality.
• Monitoring emerging trends in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, automation, and digital innovation, and translating these into concrete business opportunities.
• Designing and coordinating change management and implementation strategies for large-scale transformation projects.
• Acting as a trusted advisor to management and business stakeholders regarding digitalization initiatives and process improvements.
• Collaborating closely with key users and local offices to ensure successful adoption of new technologies.
• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives through feedback collection, process reviews, and performance monitoring.
• Building and facilitating internal communities to share best practices, success stories, and knowledge related to digital tools and AI applications.
• Serving as the link between operational teams, leadership, and technology partners to ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable business value.
This position combines business analysis, process improvement, technology consulting, AI enablement, and change management in a highly visible role.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with a genuine passion for technology, digital innovation, and Artificial Intelligence.You are likely to bring:

• Several years of experience in a digital transformation, business analysis, process improvement, consulting, or change management role.
• A solid understanding of accounting workflows, financial processes, or professional services environments. Experience within accountancy is considered a strong asset.
• A strong interest in AI technologies and their practical application in business environments.
• Experience working with digital platforms, workflow tools, automation solutions, or business software ecosystems.
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to identify inefficiencies and translate complex challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to engage users at all levels of the organization.
• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, balancing long-term strategic objectives with short-term business needs.
• The ability to explain complex technological concepts, including AI-related topics, in a simple and accessible manner.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.
• Willingness to travel regularly to various offices and work closely with local teams.
• Professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with French considered a valuable asset.
Most importantly, you enjoy helping people embrace change and are motivated by the opportunity to make technology and AI create tangible business impact.

Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Head of Network Infrastructure.The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Network Infrastructure, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.Infrastructure & Network Strategy

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
• Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
• Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
• Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.
Service Ownership & Operations

• Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
• Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
• Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.
Security & Risk Management

• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
• Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
• Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.
Vendor & Stakeholder Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
• Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
• Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.
Leadership

• Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
• Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.Experience

• Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
• Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
• Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
• Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.
Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
• Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
• Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
• Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
• Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.
Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
• Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.
Languages skills 

• English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
• French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.
